pr_title: Include Order.Tag/OrderEvent.Message in their ToString, Fix default tag values
pr_body:
<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->
⚠️ This PR is on top of #4796 due to regression changes in both algorithms. Both changes only impact order list hash values.

#### Description
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
*Include Order.Tag/OrderEvent.Message in their ToString, Fix default tag values

>There was inconsistencies in what we were checking for. The order constructors
default the tag parameter to an empty string but Order.CreateOrder checks for
a null string. Additionally, the order constructors (limit,stopmarket,stoplimit)
would check for an empty string and if so, apply a default order tag.

>This change cleans these checks up using string.IsNullOrEmpty and also removes the
check from Order.CreateOrder since we're passing the tag into the various order
constructors.

Ensure usage of default order tags and improve debugging experience by including them in the `ToString()` methods.

issue_context.title: Order.Tag in ToString; Default Order.Tag Value; OrderEvent.IsAssignment in ToString
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->
* `Order.ToString()` includes the tag.
* `LimitOrder`/`StopMarketOrder`/`StopLimitOrder` default their `Tag` properties when the `tag` constructor parameter is null or empty
* `OrderEvent.ToString()` includes `IsAssignment` when security type is option

#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->
* [`Order.ToString()`](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Common/Orders/Order.cs#L295) does not include the order tag.
* [`LimitOrder`](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Common/Orders/LimitOrder.cs#L62)/[`StopMarketOrder`](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Common/Orders/StopLimitOrder.cs#L74)/[`StopLimitOrder`](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Common/Orders/StopMarketOrder.cs#L62) default their `Tag` properties to include their limit/stop prices when the `tag` constructor parameter only when empty.
* [`OrderEvent.IsAssignment`](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Common/Orders/OrderEvent.cs#L254) is never included in `OrderEvent.ToString()`

#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->
* Add `Order.Tag` to the end of `Order.ToString()` _if_ it's not null or empty
* Update constructor checks to use `string.IsNullOrEmpty(tag)`
* Append `IsAssignment: {IsAssignment}` at the end of `OrderEvent.ToString()` when `Symbol.SecurityType == SecurityType.Option`
